requirements.quote: An endpoint MAY probe for peer reachability from a new local address using path validation (Section 8.2) prior to migrating the connection to the new local address.
requirements.condition: Before migrating a connection to a new local address.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to probe peer reachability from the new local address using path validation.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be checked to ensure that it permits and correctly supports path validation before local-address migration without requiring migration first.

requirements.quote: Failure of path validation simply means that the new path is not usable for this connection.
requirements.condition: Path validation for a new path fails.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint treats the new path as unusable for the connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not treat the failed path as usable for the connection.
requirements.error_behavior: Mark or otherwise handle the new path as unusable for this connection.
requirements.why_checkable: A focused test can force path-validation failure and verify that traffic is not migrated onto or continued over the failed path.

requirements.quote: Failure to validate a path does not cause the connection to end unless there are no valid alternative paths available.
requirements.condition: Validation of a path fails while at least one valid alternative path is available.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint keeps the connection active using a valid alternative path.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not end the connection solely because the path failed validation.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can fail validation on one path while preserving another valid path and observe whether the connection remains active.

requirements.quote: Failure to validate a path does not cause the connection to end unless there are no valid alternative paths available.
requirements.condition: Validation of a path fails and no valid alternative paths are available.
requirements.error_behavior: The connection is permitted to end.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can remove all valid alternative paths, force validation failure, and verify that connection termination is allowed in this condition.

requirements.quote: PATH_CHALLENGE, PATH_RESPONSE, NEW_CONNECTION_ID, and PADDING frames are "probing frames"
requirements.condition: A frame has type PATH_CHALLENGE, PATH_RESPONSE, NEW_CONNECTION_ID, or PADDING.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the frame as a probing frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify such a frame as a non-probing frame.
requirements.why_checkable: Frame classification can be tested directly for each of the four enumerated frame types.

requirements.quote: and all other frames are "non-probing frames".
requirements.condition: A frame has any type other than PATH_CHALLENGE, PATH_RESPONSE, NEW_CONNECTION_ID, or PADDING.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the frame as a non-probing frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify the frame as a probing frame.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's classification table or runtime behavior can be checked for every other supported frame type.

requirements.quote: A packet containing only probing frames is a "probing packet"
requirements.condition: Every frame contained in a packet is a probing frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as a probing packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify the packet as a non-probing packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Packets composed exclusively of the enumerated probing frame types can be constructed and their classification observed.

requirements.quote: and a packet containing any other frame is a "non-probing packet".
requirements.condition: A packet contains at least one non-probing frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as a non-probing packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify the packet as a probing packet, even if it also contains probing frames.
requirements.why_checkable: A mixed-frame packet can be constructed and checked to ensure that the presence of any non-probing frame determines the packet classification.
